approvals.reason: The handler has always answered null for layout when the account has no saved layout, and its description says so; only the schema claimed it was never null. Web already types it as unknown and falls back to the default layout on null; silo-apple and silo-android do not call this operation.

The handler has always answered null for updated_at when the account has no saved layout; only the schema claimed it was never null. Web already types it as string | null; silo-apple and silo-android do not call this operation.
